angles.name: General Update
angles.copy: Another packed week for The Hundred! Who's your money on to take home the trophy this year? Catch the action live across the UK.

moments.title: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean Break UK Chart Record
moments.blurb: Sam Fender and Olivia Dean's duet 'Rein Me In' has become the longest-running UK No. 1 single of all time with 19 non-consecutive weeks at the top, surpassing a 73-year-old record.

angles.name: Chart History Made
angles.copy: History made on the Official UK Singles Chart! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' is officially the longest-running No.1 single ever. Incredible!

angles.name: Sam & Olivia Triumph
angles.copy: 19 weeks and still going strong! Congrats to Sam Fender & Olivia Dean for breaking a 73-year-old record with 'Rein Me In' at No.1. What a song!

angles.name: Weekend Chart Buzz
angles.copy: The big chart news this weekend: Sam Fender and Olivia Dean have made history! 'Rein Me In' is the UK's longest-reigning No.1 single. What's your favourite No.1 of all time?
